title: The best territory bands: Troy Floyd, Trent, Moten, George Lee
summary: Tate ranks the Texas and Midwest bands and says George Lee's novelty band was good but swung less than Moten's.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Which were the best ones now? Troy Floyd?
Troy was one of the best. Alphonso Trent and Bennie Moten, Blue Devils, Troy.
Was George Lee -- did he have a band?
George Lee had a good band. They had a novelty band, but it was a good band. Very good band. George Lee had nice arrangements. Jesse Stone[?] used to write for him.
And he had a good band, but he wasn't -- he didn't swing as much as Bennie.
